title: Workspace Scan.toml: configPath, [[platform]] and invalid settings
description: Each sub folder is a workspace with one package. A workspace Scan.toml cannot set [[platform]]: the scan stops with an error at its location. It can be found through [scan] configPath in the workspace Ballerina.toml. Invalid settings are reported once for the workspace, not once per package.

steps.name: [[platform]] in the workspace Scan.toml
steps.note: Error: [[platform]] cannot be set in a workspace Scan.toml.

steps.name: Workspace Scan.toml through configPath
steps.note: The package inherits failOnSeverity = "HIGH" and fails. Also records whether bal build accepts [scan] in a workspace Ballerina.toml.
